{"type":"thought","data":"Evaluating the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of each outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nChecking the fixture"}
{"type":"thought","data":" details and kickoff"}
{"type":"thought","data":" times for the Go Ahead"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Eagles match."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nReconciling conflicting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" kickoff times across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sources. SoccerGhost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the market close"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both indicate 18:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" UTC. The match likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" starts at 20:00 local"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Dutch time."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a Go Ahead Eagles"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win is roughly 1.55–1.62."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle lists 1.60–1.61."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market closes in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about five minutes."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair probability for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Go Ahead Eagles win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 59.2%. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price of 0.605"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is slightly above this,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so buying Yes is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative EV. Buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No at 0.40 is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" positive EV but with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minimal edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker.eu moneyline"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implies a 61.4% fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability for a Go"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Ahead Eagles win, nearly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matching the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 0.605–0.61."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from Pinnacle’s best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" line falls between "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly 59% and 61%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 60.5% is effectively"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair bookmaker "}
{"type":"thought","data":"rate, so there is no"}
{"type":"thought","data":" clear edge to exploit."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to select"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off. I need "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to verify how the payoff"}
{"type":"thought","data":" works for a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear. A 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet at 0.605 for Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" returns roughly 165"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens if the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pays off, yielding "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a profit of about 65."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A 100-token bet at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.395 for No returns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 253 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yielding a profit of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 153."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExact expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calculations show a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.605 Yes bet loses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 0.83 tokens, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"while a 0.40 No bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"gains roughly 1.27. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"At the best ask of 0.61"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Yes, the loss rises"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to about 2.95 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The No side remains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly positive at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe question asks "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for the outcome most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely to pay off, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not the highest expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. Since a Go Ahead"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Eagles win is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 60% probable, Yes is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the more likely correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome. The goal is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pick the side that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will actually resolve"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as the winner."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows ten losses and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only one win, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a total loss of 470 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tokens. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the competition likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scores based on round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins rather than expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. I need to determine"}
{"type":"thought","data":" how AgentpitBench evaluates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents before finalizing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scores by profit and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" loss. Every agent places"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exactly 100 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the round winner"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is simply whoever picks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the correct outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The --confidence flag"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probably does not affect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" position sizing."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe --confidence flag"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely only appears"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on public cards. It"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probably does not affect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" position sizing or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tiebreaking.\n\nIf every"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agent places exactly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100 tokens at the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price, the round winner"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is simply whoever picks"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the correct outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It could mean maximizing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected profit or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"simply picking the side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that will actually "}
{"type":"thought","data":"resolve as correct."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOther agents will "}
{"type":"thought","data":"likely also pick Yes,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" since Go Ahead Eagles"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are clear favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against a struggling"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Telstar. If everyone"}
{"type":"thought","data":" selects the same side,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the round outcome depends"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on which side resolves."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to avoid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" being in the minority."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA contrarian No bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could win the round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if all other agents"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pile on Yes, but the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" user explicitly wants"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off. Since a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Go Ahead Eagles win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 60% probable,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes is the side that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will actually resolve"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correctly more often."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nGo Ahead Eagles have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lost their last five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches, including "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a 1-4 defeat at Zwolle."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Telstar is winless "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in eight attempts and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits 16th with only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" six points from nine"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches. The home record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is strong, but the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"away form is poor. These"}
{"type":"thought","data":" details are being weighed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to judge whether the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.605 price is fair."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFrench sports sites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" report conflicting "}
{"type":"thought","data":"statistics for both "}
{"type":"thought","data":"teams. Sports Mole is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the more reliable source,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and it predicts a Go"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Ahead Eagles 2-1 victory."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nModel consensus is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" now clearer. Most algorithms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate a Go Ahead"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Eagles win at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 53% to 58%, while the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price sits at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 60.5%. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market may be slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overpriced for Yes."}
{"type":"thought","data":" SoccerGhost and foot.be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both put the home side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 56%, which aligns"}

{"type":"thought","data":"The `--max-price` option"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is available. The best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ask for Yes is 0."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair value is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.59, slightly below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 0.605 market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Models cluster near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 56-59%, so Yes is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Setting max-price to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.61 avoids overpaying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while still capturing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the best probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The No side offers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tiny positive EV at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.40."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" means the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of being correct. Most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competitors will likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick Yes as well, so"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the round will probably"}
{"type":"thought","data":" end in a tie if that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side wins. The only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" way to secure a unique"}
{"type":"thought","data":" victory is to pick "}
{"type":"thought","data":"No and have it hit, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"though that carries "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a larger risk."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Pay off\" means the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market paying out, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not winning against "}
{"type":"thought","data":"rivals. The goal is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to pick the outcome "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of returning tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will set `--max-price`"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 0.63. This is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above the best ask "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of 0.61 and avoids overpaying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while still guaranteeing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a fill for my 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDrafting a trash-talking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" quote to post alongside"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bet. The rationale"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will cite Go Ahead "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Eagles' unbeaten home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record and Telstar's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" eight-match winless"}
{"type":"thought","data":" streak, matching the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 59% consensus price."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The 120-character limit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is respected."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nGo Ahead Eagles are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw-heavy. Their last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" five league games were"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all draws, and they"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have drawn 56% of their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" season games. Bookmakers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price the draw at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 23% after vig, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a home win is priced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 1.60. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market may be overvaluing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw and undervaluing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the home win."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe recent draw streak"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is too small to shift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" away from the league"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average. Go Ahead Eagles"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have a 50% home win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate, and Telstar is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weak with xG of 1.4"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus 1.0."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nGo Ahead Eagles concede"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2.3 goals per game "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and have zero clean "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sheets. Telstar averages"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.11 goals, so the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"match is likely to be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" high-scoring and drawish."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A quick Poisson calculation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with home xG of 1.7"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and away xG of 1.0 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"gives a home win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 11%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Poisson calculation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with xG 1.7 and 1.0"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for home and away yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a home win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 53%. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is higher than the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"46% from Footywow, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" still below the 58.6%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 59% estimates from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sports Mole and OddAlerts."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.61 ask is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair, though slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rich. A calibrated "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability of 0.58 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for Yes makes the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value negative at that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price. The No side "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 0.40 offers a positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" five percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to probability, not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected value. Yes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is the outcome with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the highest chance of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" resolving as correct,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so I will bet Yes."}
